description: This file defines a SwiftUI view named PermissionsSettings that provides a user interface for managing various permissions related to location, notifications, accessibility, and other capabilities within an application. It includes subviews for location access settings and permission status list, and handles permission requests and refreshes.

classes.name: LocationAccessSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI view managing location permission access settings, allowing users to select location mode and toggle precise location, with logic to request and handle location authorization.

classes.name: PermissionStatusList
classes.description: A SwiftUI view displaying the list of capabilities and their permission statuses, with functionality to refresh status and handle permission requests.

classes.name: PermissionRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing a single permission item, showing its status, allowing to request permissions, and indicating pending operations.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Computes and returns the main view layout for LocationAccessSettings, PermissionStatusList, or PermissionsSettings.

methods.name: onAppear
methods.description: Handles initialization when the LocationAccessSettings appears, setting lastLocationModeRaw.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles changes to locationModeRaw, requesting location authorization accordingly.

methods.name: locationMode
methods.description: Returns the current OpenClawLocationMode based on locationModeRaw.

methods.name: requestLocationAuthorization
methods.description: Asynchronous method requesting location authorization based on the specified mode.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles permission request for a specific capability, updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: refreshStatusTransitions
methods.description: Performs multiple refreshes with delays to allow permission dialogs to settle.
